answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort.. It resists because the per-account limit caps any single farm, spreading the surplus across many passing identities instead of letting one cluster monopolize it.
